items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Per operator approval (2026-10-23): vitest and @vitest/coverage-v8 3.2 -> 5.0.5, which clears both critical npm audit findings (vitest, tinypool); npm audit now reports 0 critical, 0 high, 5 moderate (react-router 6 and tailwind 3 chains, out of scope). Changes the upgrade forced: CI Node 20 -> 22 (vitest 5 requires ^22.12; Node 20 is end-of-life); jest-dom imported via its /vitest entry so matcher types attach to vitest 5's Assertion; RequestInfo in the dev middleware typed from fetch because vitest 5 no longer supplies DOM types to tsconfig.node.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: No runtime app code changed; the dev middleware edit is type-only.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Lockfile diff only removes packages or adds @vitest/istanbul-lib-coverage, @vitest/istanbul-lib-report and obug, all from the vitest org or its documented dependencies. vitest 5.0.5 was published 2026-10-15, outside the 7-day cooldown. Workflow change touches only node-version; uses: pins are unchanged.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: vitest 377/377 on 5.0.5; coverage report produced (92.2% statements, 87.7% branches); tsc app/edge/node configs pass; eslint passes; build passes with all 7 dist secret rules.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Dev tooling only; the shipped bundle is unaffected.
